versions.content: The TcpIp UDP - layer shall map received UDP datagrams to sockets based on the destination port as contained in the UDP protocol header and the local ad d ress (TcpIpAddrId). The local address (TcpIpAddrId) matches if ANY o f the following conditions is fulfilled: a) The socket is bound to the local address (TcpIpAddrId) b) The socket local address uses the wildcard “ANY” AND the socket EthIfCtrl is identical to the EthIfCtrl used in the local address (TcpIpAddrId) c) The socket is bo und to TCPIP_LOCALADDRID_ANY The socket is bound to a local address and the EthIfCtrl is identical to the EthIfCtrl used in the local address (TcpIpAddrId) and the received local address (TcpIpAddrId) is a broadcast address.
